objective: Provide zero-paid-API BUKLOD BSOC case intake, persistent low-cost technical triage, privacy-scoped member status reports, and an hourly connected ChatGPT DEV-only repair watch without exposing data or changing unrelated production behavior.
productionBaselineEvidence: Initial isolated DEV source branched from main 0a4f0b2b849f24b46b4a0643a6cc55ae539d5cdf. Current main advanced to 551e54602addd6f7bbe7bcdddd1589d35424c964 and MUST be reconciled before any client integration. Supabase MAIN yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu additive migrations bsoc_ai_autofix_reports_v1 and bsoc_zero_budget_scheduler_v1 applied on Nov 19, verified with rollback-only synthetic tests and a live empty-queue worker. No app OTA, native build, paid inference or Season2 change was made. The exact currently installed production APK/OTA remains unverified. Additional additive backend migration bsoc_member_reply_followup_v1 applied and its live trigger guards validated. Additional live additive migration bsoc_support_failopen_reliability_v1 compiled and applied for safety of normal support operations.
chosenApproach: Use existing Postgres hooks and bounded pg_cron (3 cases per 15-minute run), no Edge API; active hourly ChatGPT automation uses existing GitHub/Supabase connector actions for permitted DEV source fixes. Report phases are member-scoped; no support status is auto-closed, and final resolved messages require independently audited production fix evidence.
selectionRationale: Avoid additional paid API/CI/compute, reuse current BSOC infrastructure and notification delivery while preserving strong row-level isolation and fail-open support intake.
alternativeApproaches: Paid OpenAI API and Codex GitHub Action auto-repair rejected under zero budget; remain disabled and un-deployed.
Direct synchronous AI invocation from member support submission rejected for latency, cost, privacy and availability; use bounded asynchronous screening.
Separate Supabase paid development branch rejected for nonzero recurring costs; rollback-only database integration tests selected.
preserveBehaviors: Existing user_feedback lifecycle, 762 historical resolved cases, support chat and case evidence remain unchanged.
No changes to production reward, Season1, Season2, AdMob rendering, navigation, offline sync, auth, payout or media APIs.
The new member report table uses owner-only RLS, service-only write authorization, idempotency and fixed privacy-safe messages.
Worker never calls an external paid API, modifies canonical support case status, merges code, publishes an OTA or sets a false verified release.
acceptanceChecks: Two additive Supabase migrations compile and apply with no backfill or canonical status mutations.
Synthetic isolated data classifies a known technical signal as TRIAGED, unknown details as NEEDS_DETAILS and privacy concern as NEEDS_HUMAN.
Duplicate private member report produces one report row and one notification in rollback-only test.
Authenticated member can read own report but another account cannot; untrusted member cannot read internal jobs or forge report.
Live scheduler exists and processes an empty queue without paid API calls.
ChatGPT hourly repair watch is enabled; no guarantee of instant trigger, autonomous coding completion or paid external agent.
No native/client/Expo production release without independent DEV to RC to production safety verification.
Member follow-up transition requires exact case ownership, active nonclosed case and NEEDS_DETAILS state; trigger metadata and server guard tested without real push.
Submission, reopening and private member messages fail open if auxiliary AI queue or push reporting raises an exception; SQL compile verified with rollback.
